findings.summary: Checked-in synthetic Source artifacts retain exact SHA-256 bindings, and every supporting EvidenceLink reproducibly resolves its unique locator to the revision's source-native expression and atomic Claim.
Spatial refinement rejects changes to calendar, normalization, inclusivity, qualifiers and alternatives in its valid-time semantic envelope while allowing revision-local basis Claim links to change.
The validator enforces one series per atomic subject_ref/target_key pair, target-key/dimension compatibility and dimension-appropriate value families.

Valid time and record time remain distinct; deterministic replay, correction, unresolved alternatives, withdrawal, separate ecological world states, fuzzy ranges and geometry-null unknown routes preserve the intended scenarios.

The Drive-to-curation-to-GitHub-to-controlled-projection pipeline and minimum-fidelity stop rule remain coherent. Gate D, public capability, empty Airtable historical-write authority, project_state.json and frozen #329/#330/Gate C packages remain unchanged.
Temporal refinement retains the calendar/normalization profile and rejects every primary or alternative member outside the predecessor possible set.

The prior unchanged-unknown-alternative, open-start-to-finite, inclusivity-only and precision-only cases are fixed, but strictness is still not evaluated over the actual interval union. With recomputed ledger and package locks, the validator accepted child primary [1502-08-01,1502-08-08] plus alternative [1502-08-08,1502-08-31] as a refine of predecessor [1502-08-01,1502-08-31]. Every child member is individually contained and no parent member fits within one child member, yet the child union equals the predecessor union exactly. This violates the contract's strict-subset requirement.

The round-5 candidate is therefore CHANGES_REQUIRED.
